notes:
Used both literally (physical space in the air) and as a modifier in compound words. Very productive as a prefix in technical and descriptive compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空中|くうちゅう}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: aerial photography
- {空中|くうちゅう}{戦|せん}: aerial battle, dogfight
- {空中|くうちゅう}ブランコ: trapeze
- {空中|くうちゅう}⟦{分解|ぶんかい}→分解：08389_bunkai⟧: disintegration in midair; figuratively, falling apart
- {空中|くうちゅう}{浮遊|ふゆう}: floating in midair, levitation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上空|じょうくう}→上空：03080_joukuu⟧: the sky above — refers to a specific area overhead, often used with altitude
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: sky — the visible sky as a whole, more poetic and everyday
- ⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧: atmosphere — scientific term for the layer of air around the earth

definitions.explanation: the space in the air above the ground; midair
